overview: Based on the published agenda, the Village of Kronenwetter Board was scheduled to hold a public hearing and vote on the proposed 2027 operating budget, along with related budget resolutions and the appointment of a village clerk. The meeting was set to address multiple budget allocations across general, debt service, special revenue, capital projects, and enterprise funds.

discussions.item: Village of Kronenwetter Proposed 2027 Operating Budget
discussions.body: A public hearing was scheduled to receive community input on the proposed 2027 operating budget. The board was set to close the public hearing and consider adoption of the budget through multiple resolutions addressing different fund categories.

discussions.item: Budget Presentation for Proposed 2027 Operating Budget
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to receive a detailed presentation of the proposed 2027 operating budget prior to consideration of adoption resolutions.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-013: Adopt 2027 General Fund Operating Budget
discussions.body: The board was expected to consider and vote on a resolution to adopt the 2027 general fund operating budget and authorize the levy of taxes therefor.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-014: Adopt 2027 Budgets for Multiple Funds
discussions.body: The board was set to consider a resolution to adopt 2027 budgets for the debt service, special revenue, capital projects, and proprietary/enterprise funds.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-015: Adopt 2027 Capital Improvements Program Budget
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider a resolution adopting the 2027 capital improvements program budget.

discussions.item: Resolution 2026-016: Appoint Connie Nowak as Village Clerk
discussions.body: The board was set to consider a resolution appointing Connie Nowak to the position of village clerk.

discussions.item: Agreement for Legal Services with Wolfgram, Gamoke & Hutchinson, S.C
discussions.body: The board was scheduled to consider and possibly approve an agreement for legal services with the law firm Wolfgram, Gamoke & Hutchinson, S.C.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, with a 15-minute total limit and three-minute per-person time limit at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion. The agenda noted that limited discussion may occur but no action would be taken under public comments.
